actions.action: Check soil moisture deep in the pot with a finger or wooden skewer before watering
Lift the inner pot out of the cachepot and empty standing water after watering
Slide the plant out of the pot and inspect rhizomes and roots
If rot is found, cut away mushy tissue, let cuts dry 1-2 days, then repot
If repotting, mix universal soil 1:1 with perlite, pumice, sand or bark, or use cactus mix
Remove yellow stems at the base
Water only when soil is fully dry, about every 3-4 weeks in winter
Make sure the pot has drainage holes, replacing it if needed

reason: The answer identifies overwatering as the main cause and advises checking and repotting the roots and watering much less often, which matches the fix that worked; removing yellow stems is minor and not likely to harm the plant.
